upsert.title: Nimiq Mini Apps Competition — Cycle III
upsert.summary: Online competition to build Nimiq Mini Apps (Pay, Save, Earn and On/Off Ramp). Submissions go through GitHub; teams of up to 5.
upsert.deadlineLabel: Cycle III ends 11 Nov per HackList (timezone not stated on the official page)
upsert.eligibility: Anyone 18+ with a public GitHub profile and a Nimiq wallet; open globally except where prohibited by law or sanctions. Winners must prove citizenship of an eligible country.

prize.description: US$17,000 in USDC: US$4,000 each for the best Pay, Save, Earn and On/Off Ramp Mini Apps, plus a US$1,000 Community Council bonus.

upsert.title: Epic AI MegaJam 2026
upsert.summary: Game jam where you build a game with AI tools in Unreal Engine or UEFN. Online on itch.io, with an optional in-person event in San Francisco.
upsert.eligibility: Developers aged 18+ with an active Epic Games account; further restrictions in the Official Rules (not read).

prize.description: Cash prizes by category: 1st US$7,500, 2nd US$5,000, 3rd US$2,500 plus modifier awards (US$5,000 and 5 x US$2,500). Development continuation grants of up to US$50,000 are also mentioned.

upsert.title: thatgamejam #02
upsert.summary: Online game jam from the studio behind Journey and Sky. Solo or teams of up to five; Windows or Mac build required; AI use must be disclosed.
upsert.eligibility: Developers of all backgrounds worldwide, solo or in teams of up to five. Developers in China can enter via TapTap.

prize.description: US$10,000 cash: Best Overall US$3,000; Best Gameplay, Best Visual Design and Community's Voice US$2,000 each; TapTap's Choice US$1,000.

upsert.title: Snapmaker Innovation Fund — Phase 2
upsert.summary: Open competition for projects built around the Snapmaker U1 3D printer (mods, accessories, software). About 20 projects are funded.
upsert.eligibility: Anyone worldwide. Owning a Snapmaker U1 is recommended but not required; projects must be meaningfully connected to the U1.

prize.description: US$50,000 in cash prizes across about 20 projects, up to US$5,000 per project (Phase 1 was paid by bank transfer).

upsert.title: PCBWay 9th Project Design Contest
upsert.summary: Online hardware project design contest for individuals and teams; original projects created or updated during the submission period.
upsert.eligibility: Individuals and teams worldwide; original projects only; multiple entries allowed.

prize.description: Cash: 1st US$2,000; 2nd US$1,500 x2; 3rd US$800 x3; 10 popular-design awards of US$100. Plus coupons and hardware (Jetson Orin Nano, Raspberry Pi 5 and others).

upsert.title: Game Gauntlet SIM Jam 2026
upsert.summary: Six-week online simulation game jam on itch.io, presented by Cosmic Forces. Solo or teams of up to five; games must be rated ESRB T or lower.
upsert.eligibility: Developers worldwide, solo or teams up to 5. Cash is not paid to residents of Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Venezuela or Crimea/Donetsk/Luhansk. Winners need W-9 or W-8BEN; under-18s need a guardian.

prize.description: US$1,000 cash for 1st and US$500 for 2nd, paid in USD; top three also get trophies and sponsor prizes.

upsert.title: PixArt University Innovation Challenge 2027
upsert.summary: Global university student innovation challenge on image-sensing technology. Proposals first, then prototypes built March to July 2027; finalists present online in September 2027.
upsert.deadlineLabel: Register by 7 Dec, proposal by 14 Dec (US time); listing says 15 Dec
upsert.eligibility: Undergraduate or graduate students at accredited universities worldwide, enrolled through 30 Sep 2027; teams of 1-3.

prize.description: Cash: 1st US$10,000; 2nd US$8,000; 3rd US$6,000; five merit awards of US$3,000 (US$39,000 total).
